messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — planning a short canary cutover for the Python + TS SDK publish at 18:00 UTC during the quiet window. I want to confirm pin behavior and rollback criteria before we hit the button. @ben @sam
ben: ack, I'll be oncall. what's the plan for dist tags and the legacy sync client pin?
ashley: plan: publish canary -> verify telemetry + smoke -> rotate dist-tag to canary for npm and add a temporary pip alias tag. If canary looks good after 30m, promote to latest. Legacy sync client will remain pinned to 2.9.x for 48h.
sam: what are the smoke checks we care about? any autodeploy hooks?
maria: smoke checklist: basic init, basic generate API call, streaming chunk sanity, and size+latency histogram. I'll run the scripted smoke locally then trigger the canary test runner.
ashley: great. rollout commands (for reference):
```bash
# npm
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@1.12.0-canary canary
# promote
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@1.12.0 latest
# pip (placeholder alias approach)
# we upload wheel as 1.12.0rc1 and leave production 1.11.x pinned
```
ben: note: release-bot will push metadata to the release-notes service. we should include deprecation blurb for the old sync API in the notes.
sam: rollback criteria: any >5% error rate on core generate or any SLO breach >100ms p50 increase compared to baseline. If triggered, we 1) demote dist-tag, 2) revert canary wheel from index, 3) open an incident and revert the publish PR.
ashley: yes. also add a manual cut: if function tests fail or chat integration shows broken chunking, we revert immediately.
sdk-deploy-bot: publishing canary bundle for py:1.12.0rc1 and js:1.12.0-canary... (logs: https://ci.redwood/release/3520012345) :package:
release-bot: release notes draft created: https://releases.redwood/notes/3520012345 — includes deprecation note for sync client and migration steps.
maria: smoke runner started against canary endpoint. running generate x10, streaming verify, auth token rotation check.
ben: I see telemetry firing, but notice a small uptick in token refresh latency (+30ms). watching.
sam: if token refresh persists, we may toggle auth cache TTL back down. keep me posted.
ashley: after 15m: telemetry looks nominal, no functional regressions in smoke. proceeding to promote to latest in 15m unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
ben: +1 from me.
maria: +1, no issues on streaming.
sdk-deploy-bot: promoted npm dist-tag: @redwood/sdk-js@1.12.0 -> latest; uploaded py wheel 1.12.0 to prod index.
sam: after promotion, I'm running e2e quick pass.
release-bot: published release notes (final) and pinged #marketing for announcement scheduling.
ben: spotted one customer warning in logs referencing older sync calls — not new but flagged. I'll add a note on the incident board for follow-up.
ashley: OK, closing canary thread. we'll hold the legacy sync pin for 48h and merge the deprecation doc into the SDK docs. If anything shows up, follow rollback playbook above and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
